title: LaboratoryRegistry
description: The laboratory registry, schema 1: web/public/data/laboratories.json. One entry per laboratory, carrying what it charges for the products it sells. It is the single source of truth for prices, which are never mirrored in TypeScript. App-internal data with no outside authors, so the objects are CLOSED, as in analytes-1.schema.json: a mistyped key fails the conformance suite instead of being silently ignored at runtime.

loinc.description: A LOINC code in its printed form, as in analytes-1.schema.json.

id.description: Required. Stable slug; the schedule stores it to remember the chosen laboratory.

locale.description: Required. BCP 47 tag whose digit grouping a total in this laboratory's currency is written with.

currency.description: Required. ISO 4217 code every price in `prices` is stated in.

pricesAsOf.description: Required. The date the prices were observed, ISO YYYY-MM-DD.

source.description: Optional. Where the prices came from.

priceLine.title: PriceLine
priceLine.description: One product the laboratory sells, under its own label, and every catalog code it can satisfy. A plain test covers one code; a bundle covers many and is paid once however many of them are scheduled; a label that does not pick one code covers every code it could mean. A mass/molar pair is listed by its mass primary: costing folds aliases on both sides.

label.description: Required. The laboratory's name for the product, as given, not normalized.

price.description: Required. In the laboratory's `currency`, as of its `pricesAsOf`.

covers.description: Required. Every catalog LOINC this product can satisfy.

panelId.description: Optional. The laboratory group in panels.json this bundle is. A JSON file cannot reference another, so `covers` still lists the codes, and the conformance suite holds them equal to that group's.
